segment.source: When the content comes from StackPanel, Grid or explicitly sized controls, GroupBox uses the content DesiredSize to calculate its total height.
If the parent sets Height or MaxHeight, Avalonia layout constraints still decide clipping or scrolling.
The GroupBox below does not set Height, so its content area grows with the text rows.
GroupBox grows from the measured header, padding and content size when no height is set.
